[jimojr] Is Kirkland Signature Extra Virgin Olive Oil from Costco cheaper and better?
[jimojr] Ok, I’ll grab the Kirkland Signature Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil 2L for $21 at Costco this weekend.
ChatGPT:
The comparison should be:
Kirkland Signature Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil 2L: $21 → $10.50/L
Kirkland Signature Extra Virgin Olive Oil (3L × 2 pack = 6L): $64 → $10.67/L
Red Island Extra Virgin Olive Oil 4L: $64 → $16.00/L
Cobram Estate Extra Virgin Olive Oil 2L: $36.99 → $18.50/L
The difference between the two Kirkland options is almost nothing — the Organic 2L is actually slightly cheaper per litre ($0.17/L cheaper).
I would choose:
Kirkland Organic 2L if you don't use a huge amount → easier to keep fresh after opening.
Kirkland 3L × 2 pack if you cook with olive oil frequently → better to have a backup bottle ready.
For most households, the Kirkland Organic 2L at $21 is probably the sweet spot. It gives you organic EVOO at almost the same price as the regular Kirkland.
